selection_policy: Relevance, scientific substance, significance and incremental contribution; maximum 12, no minimum. Four independent papers selected. No overflow, companion highlights or cap-driven exclusions.
second_topic_pass: Rechecked the complete 210-candidate title/abstract inventory for cosmic rays, acceleration/transport, nuclear/EM cascades, neutrino source physics and cooling, gamma rays, multimessenger work, neutrino phenomenology, dark matter and related BSM/cosmology.
gaps: No missing requested dated listing pages at this cutoff. Coverage does not claim every arXiv category or exhaustive earlier literature.
Cross-list-only papers not selected were not all traced through announcement histories; none is used as a highlight.

The 2025 radio precursor full text was not independently recovered; its bibliography was verified and the new paper's comparison was supplemented by accessible independent infrared and transport studies.
Exact journal publication date for the radio paper was not verified; its DOI is retained without inventing a date.

revision_provenance.previous_pending_assessments: Earlier unresolved screening candidates remain with their original dated audit and were not relabeled as current announcements.
